comment: Setup was quick and support answered within the hour.
The mobile app logs me out every day and I lose my drafts.
Reports are fine but exporting to Excel loses the formatting.
Pricing jumped after the trial without a clear warning.
Good product. The onboarding videos helped.
Logged out again on mobile. Third time this week.
Export to Excel is broken for wide tables.
Would like a cheaper plan for a two-person team.
Was billed before I decided to keep it.
